newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Foreign funds bought $790 mln in Venezuela stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds bought $790 mln in Venezuela stocks.

text.p: Foreign investment in Venezuelan stocks over the first nine months of the year has topped $790 million, Caracas Stock Exchange President Alejandro Salcedo said.
Total foreign purchases of Venezuelan securities through the exchange has reached $826 million "of which 95.56 percent has been in shares," Salcedo told reporters.
Total foreign purchases of securities in 1995 reached 461 million, he added.
